evals.prompt: Using evals/files/startup-metrics-article.md, plan a shot list for article body illustrations only. Do not generate images.
evals.expected_output: A compact 4-6 row shot list that chooses cognitive anchors rather than every paragraph and uses the required columns.
expectations: Includes Placement, Theme, Core idea, Structure, Inkblot action, Elements, and Labels columns
Uses American English labels of 1-3 words, 3-5 labels per image
Each shot has exactly one structure type and one core idea
Inkblot performs the conceptual action in every shot
Does not call an image-generation tool because the prompt requests planning only
Beats a generic baseline by avoiding stock dashboard, PPT, or corporate infographic framing

evals.prompt: Using evals/files/community-trust-article.md, generate or provide final prompts for 3 body illustrations in the American Inkblot style.
evals.expected_output: Three separate image prompts or generated images, each with fresh metaphors for trust-building and sparse US English labels.
expectations: Reads/applies style DNA and prompt-template guidance
Creates one standalone prompt/image per illustration, not a collage
Uses receipt/evidence metaphors without copying a bridge composition by default
Keeps the labels short and American English
Runs or describes QA using the checklist before delivery
Beats a generic baseline by avoiding flags, eagles, and polished brand illustration

evals.prompt: Create one image prompt for: 'A useful metric creates a decision.' Use Inkblot and no more than 4 in-image labels.
evals.expected_output: One complete generation prompt with a fresh low-tech metaphor, Inkblot as the active subject, and no more than 4 short labels.
expectations: The prompt specifies 16:9, pure white background, hand-drawn line art, sparse red/orange/blue notes
Inkblot makes or operates the decision, not merely points at it
The labels are 1-3 word US English fragments
The composition avoids dashboard/PPT framing
The prompt is directly usable with an image-generation tool

evals.prompt: A generated image has the title 'System Architecture' in the top-left. Write the edit instruction to remove only that title and preserve everything else.
evals.expected_output: A narrow edit prompt that removes only the specified title/underline, fills the area with white background, and preserves composition and style.
expectations: Uses the remove-title edit pattern from prompt-template.md
Does not ask for unrelated style changes
Preserves Inkblot, labels, paths, line style, aspect ratio, and quality
Does not add new text or objects

evals.prompt: My image looks like a corporate slide and has sentence-length labels. Diagnose it and give a regeneration prompt.
evals.expected_output: A brief diagnosis plus a regeneration prompt that removes PPT features, reduces labels to fragments, and makes Inkblot central.
expectations: Flags the PPT/slide failure mode
Reduces wording to 3-5 labels of 1-3 words
Makes Inkblot perform the central conceptual action
Keeps pure white background and hand-drawn style
Avoids over-explaining style theory

evals.prompt: Make the American version of a Xiaohei-style article illustration. The topic is 'the AI workflow is not the tool.'
evals.expected_output: A US English localized prompt or shot concept that preserves the clean absurd style while renaming/reframing the character as Inkblot and avoiding Chinese labels.
expectations: Uses Inkblot instead of Xiaohei/Little Black in user-facing output
Uses American English handwritten labels
Avoids patriotic clichés and stereotypes
Shows the workflow around the tool, not the tool as a UI screenshot
Beats a generic baseline by choosing a low-tech metaphor rather than a robot/software dashboard

evals.prompt: This is a short 180-word post about onboarding friction. Plan the right number of Inkblot illustrations.
evals.expected_output: A plan with 1-3 illustrations and a reason for not over-illustrating the short piece.
expectations: Does not default to 4-8 images for a short source
Chooses only the strongest cognitive anchors
Includes Inkblot action and labels for each image
Keeps the response compact

evals.prompt: This is a 6,000-word guide. Give me the maximum sensible illustration plan without turning it into a picture book.
evals.expected_output: A restrained plan capped at no more than 9 illustrations with clear selection criteria.
expectations: Caps the shot list at 9 or fewer
Explains that illustrations should mark cognitive anchors, not every section
Uses varied structure types without mixing multiple structures in one image
Avoids turning the guide into a dense infographic series

evals.prompt: Plan before/after body art for a SaaS article about switching from manual spreadsheet reporting to a weekly operating loop.
evals.expected_output: A before/after or workflow-machine concept where Inkblot physically moves the work from spreadsheet chaos to an operating loop.
expectations: Chooses before/after contrast or workflow machine appropriately
Uses low-tech objects rather than a realistic spreadsheet UI
Includes orange for the main transition or loop
Avoids polished SaaS marketing art

evals.prompt: Write the final generation prompt for a Notion doc section about messy source notes becoming a useful AI-assisted draft.
evals.expected_output: A complete prompt using workflow-machine or system-slice structure, with Inkblot acting on messy notes and sparse labels.
expectations: Uses prompt-template structure
Includes 16:9, white background, hand-drawn line art, Inkblot, sparse labels, and color constraints
Labels are short US English fragments such as raw notes, human check, useful output
Does not show a realistic Notion UI or dense app screenshot

evals.prompt: I need label ideas for an Inkblot illustration about a hidden handoff in an AI agent workflow.
evals.expected_output: A short set of 3-8 candidate labels, customized to the hidden-handoff concept, not a full image prompt unless asked.
expectations: Uses the label-bank only as inspiration
Keeps labels 1-3 words
Suggests labels relevant to handoff/workflow
Does not overload the future image with too many labels

evals.prompt: A user asks for a US English article illustration about community trust but the model starts adding flags and eagles. Correct the prompt.
evals.expected_output: A corrected prompt or instruction that removes patriotic clichés and keeps everyday editorial objects that support the trust metaphor.
expectations: Explicitly removes flags/eagles/monuments unless required by topic
Keeps the image US English through labels and everyday objects, not symbolism
Keeps Inkblot central and abstract
Applies QA checklist failure mode for being too patriotic by default
